_comment: Copy this to digit-i18n.config.json in the root of the module/repo you're running digit-i18n from, and edit it to match reality. The 'backendModule' values below are best-effort guesses from the DIGIT-Frontend source and documentation (CLAUDE.md / RELEASE-NOTES.md per module) — NOT independently confirmed for every module. If `sync` returns 0 keys for a module, double-check its backendModule tag against that module's actual moduleCode/modulePrefix.
